errorhint.device: Check that the scanner is switched on, connected and closed, and that its Windows driver is installed. Then try again.
errorhint.device_busy: Close the scanner's own program and any other app that is scanning, then try again.
errorhint.device_crashed: Switch the scanner off and on, check the cable, and make sure nothing else is using it. If it keeps happening, update or reinstall the scanner's Windows driver, or try the flatbed instead of the feeder. Then scan again.
errorhint.engine_missing: A bundled component is missing or failed its check, so Sheaf will not run it. Reinstall Sheaf or restore the file; antivirus software sometimes quarantines it.
errorhint.internal: Something unexpected happened. Your original files were not changed. Try again; if it repeats, send a problem report.
errorhint.invalid_arg: Something in the request was not valid. Try the action again; if it keeps happening, send a problem report.
errorhint.io: Windows refused to read or write. Check that the file is not open in another program, that the folder is not read-only and that the disk has room.
errorhint.limit_exceeded: That is bigger than Sheaf allows (2 GB and 20 000 pages per file). Work on a smaller part, or split the file with another program first.
errorhint.needs_password: Enter the password when asked. Without it the file cannot be opened.
errorhint.no_paper: Put the pages in the feeder the way the scanner expects, then scan again.
errorhint.not_found: The page or file is no longer there, perhaps because the list changed. Open the file again.
errorhint.parse: The file may be damaged, or it is not really a PDF or a picture. For a damaged PDF try the Repair tool; otherwise open the original again.
errorhint.path_rejected: Sheaf will not use that location. It may be a system device name, a hidden data stream, or a file on a network share (if you turned that off). Choose an ordinary file or folder on this computer.
errorhint.timeout: The job took longer than the time limit. Try fewer pages at once, or the Fast OCR setting.
errorhint.unsupported: That is not available for this kind of file, or not in this version.
errorhint.worker_crashed: The helper process that reads documents stopped. Your original is untouched. Try again; if it repeats for one file, that file may be damaged: try Repair.

help.files.body:
# What can be opened

PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF (also with several pages), BMP and WebP.

# Locked PDFs

A PDF with a password asks for it when you open it. Without the password it cannot be opened. If the password is wrong you can try again.

# Limits

- Up to 2 GB and 20 000 pages per file.
- Pages of an extreme size are refused, to protect the computer.

# Damaged files

If a PDF will not open, try the Repair tool: it rebuilds what can still be read into a new file.

# Files on a network share

They open by default, but Windows then contacts that server. Turn this off in Settings to keep Sheaf fully offline.
help.files.title: Files, passwords and limits
help.footer: Still stuck? Open About and choose Report a problem.
help.menu.body:
Right-click one or more PDFs or pictures in Explorer and choose Sheaf: open them, or run an action or a preset.

- Several selected files are handled together as one job.
- The installer adds the menu for your user only; no administrator rights are needed.
- To add or remove it yourself: run "sheaf install-verbs" or "sheaf uninstall-verbs".

On Windows 11 it may be under "Show more options".
help.menu.title: Right-click menu
help.ocr.body:
OCR makes scanned pages searchable and lets you copy their text.

- Click OCR in the toolbar (or press F), pick the pages, languages and mode, then Recognize.
- Languages: English, Russian, Uzbek (Latin) and Uzbek (Cyrillic). "Detect automatically" tries them.
- Add missing text skips pages that already have text. Redo all text replaces it. Extract text only writes a .txt file.
- Doubtful words are marked; press ] to jump to the next one.
- In Settings you can have pages without text recognized automatically when you open a file, or never.

Accurate quality needs the accurate language data; Fast works out of the box.
help.ocr.title: Text recognition (OCR)
help.pages.body:
- Click selects a page, Shift+click a range, Ctrl+click adds or removes one, Ctrl+A selects all. Arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home and End move around.
- R turns the selected pages to the right, Shift+R to the left.
- Delete removes the selected pages.
- Ctrl+D duplicates them.
- Drag pages in the list to reorder them.
- Ctrl+Z undoes and Ctrl+Y redoes (up to 100 steps).

Everything happens in Sheaf's page list. The files on your disk change only when you export.
help.pages.title: Pages: select, turn, reorder
help.presets.body:
A preset is a saved recipe: clean up pages, recognize text, split, name the files, compress and choose where results go.

- Click Presets in the toolbar to make, change or delete them.
- Run one from the Presets window, the action wheel or the right-click menu.
- A preset works on every file you give it and never overwrites anything.
help.presets.title: Presets
help.privacy.body:
- Sheaf works offline. It has no network features, no telemetry and no account.
- Your original files are never changed. Results are new files, and an existing file is never replaced.
- Documents are opened by a separate helper process with limited rights, so a damaged or hostile file cannot reach the rest of the system.
- Scratch files live in a private folder and are deleted when the app closes.
- Settings and presets are stored for your user only, in %APPDATA%\Sheaf. They hold no document content and no passwords.
- A problem report is only text on your screen until you copy or save it yourself. It never holds documents, file names or folder names.
help.privacy.title: Privacy and safety
help.scan.body:
Click Scan in the toolbar, choose the scanner, then source (flatbed or feeder), double-sided, resolution, colour and paper size.

- Pages appear as they arrive and can be recognized at the same time.
- If the scanner is busy, close its own program and try again.
- If the feeder is empty, load the pages and scan again.
- A scan that is cancelled or fails keeps the pages already received.

Scanning uses the scanner's Windows driver (WIA). If your scanner is not listed, check that it works in Windows' own Scan app.

If a scan seems slow: after every scan Sheaf writes how long each step took (sizes and times only, no content) to scan-timing.txt in %APPDATA%\Sheaf.
help.scan.title: Scanning
help.shortcuts.body:
- Ctrl+O: open files
- Ctrl+E: export
- Ctrl+F: search
- Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y: undo / redo
- Ctrl+A: select all pages
- Ctrl+D: duplicate the selected pages
- R / Shift+R: rotate right / left
- Delete: remove the selected pages
- F: recognize text on the selected pages
- ]: next doubtful word
- Esc: clear the selection or close a window
- F1: this Help
help.shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.start.body:
Sheaf edits PDFs and scans on this computer. It works offline: nothing is uploaded, and your original files are never changed.

# Open files

- Press Ctrl+O, click Open, or drop files on the window.
- PDFs and pictures (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, WebP) can be mixed in one go.
- A locked PDF asks for its password.

# Work on pages

The pages are listed on the left. Click one to see it large in the middle; the tools are on the right.

# Save your work

Click Export (Ctrl+E). Sheaf always writes a new file and never replaces an existing one: if the name is taken it adds -2, -3 and so on. Your originals stay as they were.
help.start.title: Getting started
help.title: Help
help.tools.body:
The Tools tab on the right lists them; the box at the top searches.

- Merge: open more files, then export.
- Split: many files by page count, blank sheet, text or ranges.
- Extract pages: export only the selected pages.
- Remove pages: delete the selected pages.
- Organize: insert a blank page; drag pages to reorder.
- Rotate and Crop: turn pages; cut a page down to a frame.
- Compress: Low (repack only), Recommended (pictures to 150 dpi) or Extreme (96 dpi).
- Images to PDF and PDF to images.
- Stamp: a watermark or page numbers.
- Lock: set a password and restrictions, or save an unlocked copy.
- Repair: rebuild a damaged PDF into a new file.
- Info: see, change or remove a PDF's title, author and hidden data. It saves a copy next to the original.

Every result is a new file; the original is never touched.
help.tools.title: Tools
help.trouble.body:
# A red message appears

Click Details in it: it says what happened and what to try. Messages are kept under the bell in the toolbar.

# Sheaf does not start, or says a component is missing

Reinstall Sheaf. Antivirus software sometimes quarantines bundled files; restore them or add an exception for the Sheaf folder.

# The window is blank or opens slowly

Sheaf draws with OpenGL and falls back to Direct3D when OpenGL is not available (some virtual machines and remote desktops). Updating the graphics driver can help.

# Windows warns about an unknown publisher

The installer is not signed yet. Choose More info, then Run anyway, if you downloaded it from the official place.

# A file will not open or export

Check that it is not open in another program and that the folder is writable. For a damaged PDF try Repair.

# Still stuck

Open About and choose Report a problem.
help.trouble.title: When something goes wrong
help.wheel.body:
Select files in Explorer or on the desktop and press the hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+Space by default). A wheel appears at the pointer.

- Click an action or press its number: Merge, Compress, OCR, Split, PDF to images, Images to PDF, Rotate, Open in Sheaf.
- Hover Compress or OCR for their options, then click one.
- Actions that do not fit the selected files are dimmed. Esc closes the wheel.
- The result is written next to the original; the wheel shows the new file and a button to show it in its folder.

The wheel needs the small helper that lives near the clock. If nothing happens, start Sheaf from the welcome window or run "sheaf tray". Its icon's menu can start it with Windows. You can change the hotkey in Settings.
